Jordan / Alex / team,

I reviewed connector_ops_spec_v1.pdf quickly and sketched a compatibility matrix (attached). High-level tech notes:

- Operator expectations: we need a health probe and a metrics endpoint (Prom format) to wire into Redwoods runtime autoscaler. If VectorWorks can expose /health and /metrics by default we can avoid an adaptor.
- Auth: token exchange flow is fine but well require short-lived tokens (15m) for KV cache writes; longer refresh flows are ok for indexing.
- Data residency: for customers in EU we require S3-compatible endpoints compliant with our signed data residency addendum; that may impact how the operator selects endpoints.

I attached my draft compatibility matrix: compatibility_matrix_draft.xlsx.

Proposed next steps: 1) run a 1-hour ops smoke test in our sandbox with VectorWorks operator image, 2) capture any operator-side config flags we need to expose, 3) agree on a minimal telemetry set.

I can take the ops test lead if Alex can drop a test image and credentials.

Ben
Sr. Systems Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operator compatibility and waiver for connector onboarding

Thanks Ben — great detail. Quick legal/commercial notes:

- We can support a "one-click" install UX but need VectorWorks to sign a partner addendum that limits operator privileges and includes standard audit log access for debugging. That addendum can be a lightweight DocuSign flow (I added a link below).
- For customers that select managed installs we will require a partner SLA acceptance template.
- Regarding the waiver: Redwood legal prefers a Partner Installer Acknowledgment that sits at the account level rather than a per-customer waiver. It confirms the partner is responsible for their operator image and supply chain attestation.

Ive prepared a draft partner NDA / addendum and uploaded a signed copy template (partner_nda_redwood_signed.pdf). Please review and confirm whether VectorWorks can accept the addendum or needs redlines. Ive also included a DocuSign link to speed signatures: https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABC-Connector-NDA

If were all aligned, legal@redwood.ai should be able to sign within 48 hours.

Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
